source.paper: Celik, Hajian and Kunz, An Exact Single-Rotating Near-Horizon Geometry in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity

conformal_boundary.topology: flat torus if finite psi period is imposed; otherwise cylinder/noncompact psi factor
conformal_boundary.psi_period: not fixed by local conical regularity

horizon_measure.warning: Finite part depends on cutoff defining function and is not a physical entropy or charge without covariant phase-space justification.

reference_grid.numeric_method: 17-significant-digit binary64 evaluations; exact formulas and symbolic series are in the replay script

claim_ceiling: Exact intrinsic geometry and regulated horizon-volume expansion for the noncompact local near-horizon solution. No unique renormalized entropy/charge, finite phase space, or global parent spacetime is established.
